description:
Let’s see how to use the ICICI Direct Markets app for investing and trading stocks, futures and options, and more. 

Download the app and start investing now: https://play.google.com/store/apps/details?id=com.icicidirect.idirectsuper&hl=en&gl=US

The app packs a ton of features that you can take advantage of. I’ve briefly explained what are these features and how to use them on the ICICI direct markets app in Hindi. Find out how to buy and sell stocks, how to trade commodities, futures, and options, how to invest in Indian as well as international stocks, and mutual funds, how to research and find stocks to invest in, and more features of the app in this video.
